马克根 - 火焰

又名草稿模式。适合低 VRAM 硬件在进一步处理图像之前测试提示生成。

马克根终极版 - 暴雪

用于生成图像、升级并改善细节的 SDXL 工作流程

仪器设备（你需要什么）

  • 通过 ComfyUI 管理器安装的自定义节点（rg Three / mikey / was / Impact Pack / Impact Subpack）

  • 详细信息用于毛茸茸的人物面部检测（NSFW）

执行工作流程

我们不会点击右上角的“播放”按钮。相反，请在节点上单击它。

每个后处理的解释

  • 加载图片– 有 2 个图像加载器（导入图像并从生成中选择图像）

  • 潜在高档– 升级并在图像中创建更多细节。

  • 高分辨率修复– 使用模型将图像升级为高分辨率并提供高质量图像。保持低噪声值，因为此过程会构建不稳定的解剖结构。

  • 面部修复– 不高档。自动检测并构建更多面部细节。有时无法在特定的头部姿势下检测到面部（罕见）。

  • 升级至 4K– 将图像放大至 4K 分辨率。

使用 Bypasser 是不可能的，因为它会说缺少输入。如果它有效，只需关闭图像处理，工作流程就会更容易使用。该节点留在那里只是为了让您知道。

相反......手动连接节点（蓝线）。注意流量流向何处。

Uuhh... welcome to my lab. *ehek... scratches head* I don't usually invite people down here... Actually, I don't even come down here that often myself. Mostly when I run out of buzz... or when I need to access checkpoints that aren't available on-site. Oh, also when I need to generate a trained LoRA. I built all of this myself! >.< and I always use it. It may look a little... messy. Well... go ahead. Take a look around.

MARKGEN - FLAME

akaDraft Mode. Suitable for low-VRAM hardware to test prompt generation before processing the image further.

MARKGEN ULTIMATE - BLIZZARD

SDXL workflow to generate images, upscale, and improve details

APPARATUS(what you need)

  • Custom nodes installed through ComfyUI manager (rgthree / mikey / was / impact pack / impact subpack)

  • Fdetailerfor furry-type character face detection (NSFW)

EXECUTE WORKFLOW

We're not going to click the 'play' button in the top-right. Instead, click it on the node.

EVERY AFTER-PROCESSING EXPLAINED

  • Load Image– There are 2 image loaders (import image & select image from generation)

  • Latent Upscale– Upscale and create more detail in the image.

  • Hi-Res Fix– Upscale image using model to a high resolution and furnish into high-quality image. Stay in low denoise value since this process build unstable anatomy.

  • Face Fix– Does not upscale. Automatically detect and build more details to the face. Sometimes face cannot be detected at a certain head pose (rare).

  • Upscale to 4K– Enlarge image to 4K resolution.

Using Bypasser is not possible since it will say there are missing inputs. If it had worked, the workflow would be much easier to use by simply toggling off image processing. The node stays there just to let you know.

Instead… connect nodes manually (blue line). Pay attention to where the flow goes.

Face Detailer Setting
